symptom: describe page -> exec on a Studio Pro-built project rewrote the typed-array marker of a LayoutGridColumn.Widgets list whose first child is a Forms$TabControl from 2 to 3 (ako/mxcli-ledger FINDINGS #170)
cause: codec partListMarker derives a list's marker from its first child's $Type via RegisterListMarker, defaulting to 3; Forms$TabControl had no registration. The same 3 default also hit an emptied Widgets list and the selective-rebuild path (a stored list with one dirty child), which never consult child-type markers
insight: The marker belongs to the property, not to the child: 22,000+ Widgets lists across TestApp and PedApp, every owner, empty or not, are 2, while TabControl.TabPages is 3 (32/32). Per-child registration is whack-a-mole that leaves every unregistered widget type and both the empty and the selective paths on 3; a one-file sweep of markers grouped by owner.key and first child settles it. Register by STORAGE owner name (Forms$FormCallArgument, not gen's LayoutCallArgument).
